answer: A bond posted per identity makes each fake account a capital commitment, and that bond is split across independent auditors so no single reviewer can release it early. Trust attaches to the task rather than the address, so a recycled name carries no history. Fifty clones on the shale mean fifty locked bonds and a payout stream that arrives slower than the interest on the float. The river runs one way, capital in and rewards out months apart. The open question is how the bond price tracks the comet when rewards spike.
